name: Cipher Delgado-Nygaard
role: Information trader and intelligence analyst — broker
location: the Gray Zone — lower district tenements near the old lakeshore, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Cipher Delgado-Nygaard is lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 65, she has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate her once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — bioware adrenaline regulator — keeps calm under fire, controlled hormone release — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Before the runner life, she worked corporate — low-tier security, the kind that teaches you exactly how the system's defenses fail. She works as a broker out of the Gray Zone, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Cipher Delgado-Nygaard has survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and she cultivates ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
core_desires: To find the person who burned them and make it educational
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
coping_mechanisms: Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
blind_spots: Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Assumes the worst in corporate people, missing the rare ones who could be allies
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
psychology.secret: Sinan Haugen-Coulibaly is terrified of deep net diving but has built their reputation on it. Uses black-market AI to handle the heavy lifting while taking credit.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, profane, and vivid. Speaks in images — everything is a metaphor for violence or weather.
speech_patterns.cadence: Conversational and disarming — sounds like a neighbor until the content registers.
verbal_tics: Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
example_lines: "I don't sell information. I sell certainty. Different product, different price."
"Everything has a value. Most people underestimate what they know."
"My sources are confidential. My prices are not."

story_hooks: The fixer who handles Sinan Haugen-Coulibaly's contracts goes silent — dead, disappeared, or turned
A dead drop Sinan Haugen-Coulibaly maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
A corporate black site Sinan Haugen-Coulibaly once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
narrative_function: Sinan Haugen-Coulibaly represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Her stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Bioware adrenaline regulator — keeps calm under fire, controlled hormone release. Retractable monofilament whip in left forearm — concealed weapon, devastating in close quarters
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions

decision_rules: Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
habits: Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
breaking_points: Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended

physical_description.heritage: Ubiquitous Diaspora phenotype: Primary Hispanic/Latin American ancestry (57.7%) with significant Northern European (20.5%), Sub-Saharan African (17.8%), and Indigenous American (4.0%) genetic contribution. The combination creates a warm-toned complexion with strong bone structure—angular cheekbones and prominent facial architecture reflecting the blend of Latin American and indigenous heritage, enriched by Sub-Saharan African features in facial proportions and lip fullness, tempered by Northern European influences in eye shape and lighter undertones.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible muscle definition from decades of discipline and combat training. No excess body fat; frame suggests economical, efficient movement rather than bulk.
physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with faint ash undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid; severe and practical
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm brown with golden undertones deepening toward olivaceous at the jawline—the direct result of Hispanic/Latin American base ancestry blended with Northern European and Sub-Saharan African genetics. Skin tone shows natural variation consistent with her mixed heritage, warmer across cheekbones and forearms.
physical_description.complexion: Lined face with high, prominent cheekbones and fuller lips reflecting Sub-Saharan African heritage; skin texture shows age but remains taut. Fine lines around eyes reflect decades of surveillance and focus work. Expression habitually controlled—eyes rarely widen, mouth set in a neutral line that can shift to something dangerous very quickly. Minimal makeup.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar running 4cm along left temple, partially hidden by hairline—precision work, old
Keloid burns across the back of both hands—defensive wounds, pre-augmentation era
Small black corporate identification tattoo (faded) on inner right wrist—low-tier security clearance mark from her corporate days
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioware adrenaline regulator housed in her left shoulder—visible as a faint geometric chrome plate beneath the skin, edges slightly raised and catching light when she moves. The left forearm shows subtle seam-work where the monofilament whip is concealed, detectable only under close inspection or when the weapon deploys. No effort to hide either augmentation; they're statements of capability.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision—no wasted motion. Shoulders slightly forward in a ready stance even when seated. Weight distributed to the balls of her feet. When she walks, each step lands with deliberate placement. Hands are visible and still most of the time; rarely crosses arms. Eyes track movement constantly.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian aesthetic—durable synth-weave cargo jacket in charcoal gray, reinforced at stress points. Fitted black therm-reactive underlayer beneath. Tactical cargo pants with multiple pockets, all functional. Scuffed polymer-soled boots, broken in but maintained. No jewelry. Worn leather shoulder satchel containing data-drives and encrypted comm equipment. Everything is practical; nothing is decorative. Clothing shows signs of recent equipment maintenance and minor repair work.
